card.name: Space before cycle length number; CYP2 digit
card.fires_on: The space or digit right before an expected number: after 'cycle length is' / 'period length is' in math text, and the '2' in CYP2C19 or CYP2C9 enzyme names in drug labels.

modes.label: Number after cycle length
modes.description: The blank space just before a numeric value after 'cycle length is' or 'period length is'.

modes.label: Digit in CYP enzyme names
modes.description: The digit 2 inside CYP2C19 or CYP2C9, or the piece after 'phosphodiester' or 'C' in enzyme names.

card.plain: It marks the spot right before a number or digit that is about to be spelled out, such as a cycle length or the 2 in CYP2C19.
